material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: squat horned demon idol in brown stone, 1.1 m: hunched shoulders, arms folded on the belly, five horns, sunk eyes and a wide mouth
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A fused blob figure with pressed-in eyes and mouth: it reads as a worn idol at gameplay distance, but there is no cut detail (fingers, teeth, ornament) and the horns are plain cones. The game pushes this idol along the floor; no base slab is modelled. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
